text: The authors state the sketch only works in low-stakes contexts where many bad actions are needed to cause unacceptable outcomes. In high-stakes contexts key claim 4 (that we are in a low-stakes context) breaks by definition, and key claim 3 (that the error rate will stay consistent throughout deployment) breaks because online training can no longer be relied on, opening up alignment faking and other distribution-shift problems.
title: Safety case covers only low-stakes contexts; claims 3 and 4 break in high stakes
